name: Namecheap
tagline: Budget shared hosting with cPanel, a free domain, and 24/7 live chat
description: Namecheap is a budget web hosting and domain registrar offering three shared hosting tiers — Stellar, Stellar Plus and Stellar Business — built on the industry-standard cPanel control panel, with a free domain on annual plans and 24/7 live chat support.
about: Namecheap's shared hosting comes in three tiers: Stellar (3 websites, 20GB SSD storage), Stellar Plus (unlimited websites, unmetered SSD storage), and Stellar Business (unlimited websites, 50GB SSD storage, higher-performance resources). All three run on cPanel rather than a custom control panel, include unmetered bandwidth, free SSL, and a free domain on longer-term plans.

Namecheap raised its shared hosting renewal prices starting May 19, 2026, citing rising costs — renewal rates now run $5.88/month (Stellar), $7.88/month (Stellar Plus) and $11.88/month (Stellar Business) on monthly billing, with lower effective rates on annual and two-year terms. Introductory promotional pricing is typically well below these renewal rates on the first term; check Namecheap's current pricing page for the live promotional rate before buying, since it changes periodically.
policies: Namecheap backs shared hosting plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee (extended from its previous 14-day window).

faqs.a: Yes — Namecheap's shared hosting plans run on the industry-standard cPanel control panel, unlike some budget hosts that build their own custom dashboard.

faqs.q: Is Namecheap's advertised price what I'll pay on renewal?
faqs.a: No. Namecheap's lowest prices are introductory/promotional for the first term; shared hosting renewal prices increased as of May 19, 2026 to $5.88-$11.88/month depending on plan and billing term — check the current renewal rate for your specific plan before buying.

faqs.q: Does Namecheap offer a free domain?
faqs.a: Yes, on longer-term (typically annual or longer) shared hosting plans — check the specific plan's terms for eligibility.

faqs.q: Does Namecheap offer a money-back guarantee?
faqs.a: Yes — Namecheap backs its plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee, so you can request a refund if it's not a good fit.

faqs.q: Does Namecheap include a free SSL certificate?
faqs.a: Yes — every Namecheap plan includes a free SSL certificate so your site is secured over HTTPS from day one.
